title: New patient, right knee pain after a hike

turns.text: Hi Daniel, I'm Sam, I'll get you checked in. What brings you in today?
My right knee hurts. It's been bugging me since a hike two weekends ago.
Sorry to hear that. When exactly did it start?
About two weeks ago, coming down a steep trail.
On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain right now?
Right now it's about a four.
Let me get your vitals. Your blood pressure is one thirty-eight over eighty-six.
Is that high?
A little. Your pulse is seventy-eight, temperature ninety-eight point four, and your oxygen is ninety-eight percent.
Your weight is two twelve point six pounds. And how tall are you?
Five foot ten.
Do you have any allergies to medications?
No, no allergies that I know of.
What medications do you take?
Just one. Lisinopril, ten milligrams, once a day.
Any medical conditions we should know about?
Just high blood pressure.
Have you had any surgeries?
I had my appendix out in 2010.
Do you smoke?
I used to smoke, but I quit about five years ago.
Do you drink alcohol? How many drinks a week?
Yes, about two beers a week.
And how often do you exercise?
I hike or bike three or four days a week.
Did you get a flu shot this season?
Yes, I got it in September.
Hi Daniel, I'm Dr. Lee. Any fever, chest pain, trouble breathing, cough, headaches, dizziness, or nausea?
No, none of that. Just the knee.
Okay. Let's take a look at it.

notes: Demo visit: every answer is said plainly once. Must stay empty: ALLERGENS and REACTION (no known allergies; the form skips them). Checks: blood pressure said as one phrase; weight 'two twelve point six'; height 'five foot ten' is 70 inches; quit five years ago is Former.
